extraction_notes: Characterization, DFT, and literature-comparison entries were excluded. SI Table S5 was used only for the 'This work' row; all other rows are literature data. SI Table S3 and SI Table S4 report methanol TOF values, but the output schema has no dedicated TOF field; their associated condition information was not used as standalone records except where matching conversion/selectivity/STY data were available. SI Figure S5b selectivity-vs-conversion traces and SI Figure S16 STY-vs-defect plot were not fully extracted because plotted points overlap/are not sufficiently tied to exact temperatures or conditions beyond data already captured elsewhere.
